typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FCMGMIFeeReconIntellimatchNFAcopy_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		itemId as string,
		Type as string,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FFCIntlNFArd
FFCIntlNFArd sink(input(
		itemId as string,
		Type as string,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		itemId,
		Type,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte),
	partitionFileNames:[($FCMGMIFeeReconIntellimatchNFAcopy_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> FCMGMIFeeReconIntellimatchNFAcopy
